description: This file implements the HttpRequest class, which handles HTTP request parsing, including URI splitting, and provides methods to access request details such as method, command, parameters, and post data. It also includes a reply method to send responses over a network connection.

classes.name: HttpRequest
classes.description: A class representing an HTTP request, capable of parsing request details and sending responses.

methods.name: HttpRequest::HttpRequest
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the HttpRequest object by parsing the URI and request info.

methods.name: HttpRequest::getMethod
methods.description: Returns the HTTP method of the request.

methods.name: HttpRequest::getCommand
methods.description: Returns the command part of the URI.

methods.name: HttpRequest::getPostData
methods.description: Returns the POST data of the request.

methods.name: HttpRequest::getParams
methods.description: Returns the URI parameters as a vector of strings.

methods.name: HttpRequest::reply
methods.description: Sends a reply message over the network connection.
